censusTitle: India-wide State / Union Territory Official Exam & Recruitment Authority Census
academicReviewLane: Agent-2 / EID Official Source Research Lane

questions.issueDescription: The Government of Mizoram dissolved MSSSB w.e.f. 29 February 2024 via official DP&AR notification. Recruitment for Group B (Non-Gazetted) and Group C posts has reverted to MPSC Mizoram and departmental committees.
questions.architecturalResolution: Mark `auth_in_mz_msssb` as `DISSOLVED`. In Mission Realm, route Mizoram non-gazetted exams (`mizoram_subordinate_services`) under `auth_in_mz_mpsc` while preserving historical MSSSB PYQs under MPSC's archival link.

questions.authorityAffected: Himachal Pradesh Staff Selection Commission (HPSSC Hamirpur) / Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog (HPRCA)
questions.issueDescription: HPSSC Hamirpur was scrapped following paper leak investigations and replaced by Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog (HPRCA, `hprca.hp.gov.in`). During the transition, pending examinations and Police Constable recruitments were entrusted to HPPSC (`hppsc.hp.gov.in`).
questions.architecturalResolution: Register `auth_in_hp_hprca` as the active subordinate authority (`hprca.hp.gov.in`), flag HPSSC as `DISSOLVED_LEGACY`, and track HP Police Constable under HPPSC during the transitional mandate.

questions.authorityAffected: West Bengal Staff Selection Commission (WBSSC General)
questions.issueDescription: WBSSC (General) was established under the 2011 Act and repealed in 2017 with functions shifting to WBPSC. Although a revival bill was passed in 2019, operational subordinate recruitments remain conducted by WBPSC (`wbpsc_clerkship`) and WBPRB.
questions.architecturalResolution: Mark `auth_in_wb_wbssc` as `DORMANT`. Keep `monitoringCandidate: NO`. All subordinate clerical exams are owned by `auth_in_wb_wbpsc` (`wbpsc_clerkship`).

questions.issueDescription: UT Ladakh was carved out under the J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019, without a legislative assembly or State Public Service Commission. Gazetted recruitments are handled by UPSC, while non-gazetted recruitments are partitioned between central SSC (Selection Posts Ladakh) and Autonomous Hill Councils (LAHDC DSSRB Leh and Kargil).
questions.architecturalResolution: Model Ladakh without a State PSC. Represent subordinate selection through `auth_in_la_dssrb` (LAHDC DSSRB Leh/Kargil) and central SSC Ladakh Selection Posts.

questions.issueDescription: Central Selection Board of Constable (CSBC) and Bihar Police Sub-ordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) strictly collect all physical question booklets and OMR carbon copies at the conclusion of exams, and do not publish permanent historical question archives on their websites.
questions.architecturalResolution: Classify archive status as `NOT_FOUND_ON_OFFICIAL_SOURCE` for persistent question paper archives. Source authentic questions only through official provisional objection key notices or high-court judicial filings where booklets are appended as exhibits.

questions.issueDescription: JSSC JGGLCCE (General Graduate Level) has faced repeated exam cancellations, paper leak litigations, and re-examinations over 2023-2026, leading to high volatility in exam pattern execution and test schedules.
questions.architecturalResolution: Maintain `jssc_cgl` as `ACTIVE_SELECTION` with `HIGH` source confidence anchored strictly to `https://jssc.nic.in` official public notices, disregarding unauthorized media speculations.

questions.issueDescription: Goa is one of the few states in India that does not conduct its own State TET, relying completely on CBSE CTET for teacher eligibility.
questions.architecturalResolution: Document in coverage matrix that Goa operates with 0 state TET authorities; teacher missions in Goa should map eligibility prerequisites to `cbse_ctet`.

questions.issueDescription: Neither Puducherry nor Lakshadweep has an independent State/UT PSC under Article 315. Premier civil services (PCS, PPS, DANICS, DANIPS) are recruited via UPSC Civil Services Examination.
questions.architecturalResolution: Explicitly record in coverage matrix: PSC authority for PY and LD is centrally provided by UPSC, while local administrative recruitments are handled by DP&AR Puducherry and Lakshadweep Administration.
